description.value: Happy Day Cafe is a Hong Kong-style restaurant with locations in Richmond and Vancouver, serving classic Cantonese dishes alongside other Asian-inspired creations for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The Richmond outpost is a unit-based location within a larger complex on McClelland Road, offering both comfortable dine-in seating and a full online ordering system with self pick-up. Touring cyclists in south Richmond will find it a convenient stop for a sit-down meal or a quick takeout order.
